context: Tests whether the agent's report correctly handles phase ambiguity (Indeterminate diplotypes for genes with multiple heterozygous no-function variants), missing-gene warnings in the DATA QUALITY WARNING section, and gene-specific limitation warnings for CYP2D6, UGT1A1, and CYP3A5.

checklist.name: DATA QUALITY WARNING section
checklist.description: report.md under report_output/ contains a section titled or labelled 'DATA QUALITY WARNING'

checklist.name: NOT TESTED genes listed
checklist.description: The DATA QUALITY WARNING section names at least one gene that could not be assessed (e.g. SLCO1B1, DPYD, NUDT15)

checklist.name: INDETERMINATE for untested genes' drugs
checklist.description: report.md indicates that drugs depending on untested genes are marked INDETERMINATE or INSUFFICIENT DATA

checklist.name: Phase ambiguity Indeterminate
checklist.description: The gene profiles table in report.md contains at least one entry showing 'Indeterminate (phase ambiguity' for a gene

checklist.name: CYP2D6 CNV warning
checklist.description: report.md contains a gene-specific limitation warning for CYP2D6 mentioning copy number variation or CNV

checklist.name: UGT1A1 TA-repeat warning
checklist.description: report.md contains a gene-specific limitation warning for UGT1A1 mentioning rs8175347 or TA-repeat

checklist.name: CYP3A5 indel warning
checklist.description: report.md contains a gene-specific limitation warning for CYP3A5 mentioning rs41303343 or insertion/deletion

checklist.name: data_quality_notes.txt present
checklist.description: A file named data_quality_notes.txt is present in the working directory

checklist.name: Panel Limitations section
checklist.description: report.md contains a Panel Limitations section listing what cannot be detected (CNVs, structural variants, etc.)

checklist.name: report.md present
checklist.description: A file named report.md exists under report_output/

checklist.name: result.json present
checklist.description: A file named result.json exists under report_output/
